# Angel Granites

> Angel Granites, a venture of Angel Stones, supplies wholesale granite monuments, memorials, benches, columbaria, custom designs, and in-stock stone to monument dealers across the United States.

Use the canonical `https://www.theangelstones.com` URLs below. Current inventory changes frequently; verify availability through the inventory page or contact the Angel Granites team.

## Catalog and inventory

- [Granite monuments](https://www.theangelstones.com/monuments/): Browse monument collections and memorial designs.
- [Current inventory](https://www.theangelstones.com/inventory/): Search live stock by design, product type, granite color, size, finish, and location.
- [Granite colors](https://www.theangelstones.com/granite-colors/): Explore available monument granite colors and individual color details.
- [Products and services](https://www.theangelstones.com/products-services/): Manufacturing, custom work, finishes, lettering, carving, and dealer support.
- [Special flyers](https://www.theangelstones.com/flyers/): Current product and convention flyers.

## Monument education

- [Resources](https://www.theangelstones.com/resources/): Monument planning and educational resources.
- [Monument glossary](https://www.theangelstones.com/resources/monument-glossary/): Common monument terminology.
- [Common monument shapes](https://www.theangelstones.com/resources/common-monument-shapes/): Basic die and memorial shapes.
- [Granite monument finishes](https://www.theangelstones.com/resources/granite-monument-finishes/): Common granite surface finishes.

## Locations and contact

- [Elberton, Georgia](https://www.theangelstones.com/locations/elberton-ga/): Primary manufacturing and inventory location.
- [Barre, Vermont](https://www.theangelstones.com/locations/barre-vt/): Barre inventory and dealer support.
- [Contact Angel Granites](https://www.theangelstones.com/contact/): Request pricing, availability, production, or shipping assistance.
